task.title: Materialize one exact claimed schedule revision
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/839 by exposing atomic schedule-to-task materialization through the explicit CLI boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Validate schedule and task identities before storage access.
Atomically append schedule materialization and task creation for one exact claimed revision.
Reject collisions and lifecycle failures without orphan tasks or partial output.

attempts.diagnostic: Focused materialization tests failed because materialize was an unrecognized subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the required success, absence or conflict, validation, and fail-closed paths.

attempts.summary: Implemented the bounded contract and refactored only demonstrated duplication.
attempts.diagnostic: The capability existed below the requested boundary or required one new typed kernel operation.
attempts.patch: Added the ScheduleStore::materialize adapter and covered success, stale and wrong-state schedules, task collisions, validation, and storage failures.

outcome.summary: Callers can atomically bind one claimed schedule to one task while dispatch, workflow movement, providers, tools, and execution remain external.

lessons: Cross-stream materialization must be atomic so collisions cannot create orphan tasks.
Task creation from intent is still not dispatch or execution authority.
